name: Pragya
greetingText: I really like your vibe, but Rooh suits your sweet soul even better! ✨
wishText: May your life be filled with endless smiles, pure happiness, and magical moments, Rooh! 🌸💖
textInChatBox: Wishing the sweetest Pragya (our lovely Rooh) the absolute happiest of birthdays! May all your dreams turn into reality this year... 🎉🎂✨
text2: I wanted to give you a special surprise, Pragya
text3: So I thought about it for a long time...
text4: I realized, I wanted to do something
outroText: Hope you loved this little surprise, Rooh!
